summary: MediPassport backend: 34/34 pytest cases PASSED covering health, auth (login/register/refresh/logout/lockout/2FA full loop incl. TOTP + backup code), profiles CRUD + health update, records upload/list/filter/download/delete + validation (bad category/mime/25MB), shares w/ PIN + revoke (410), sessions incl. revoke-all, audit sorted desc, zip export, AI (Gemini) multi-turn recall + summarize + history clear, vitals CRUD incl. blood_pressure value2 + invalid type, Solana status + anchor (devnet SOL available today — real signature returned and cached on retry), Emergency token public flow + revoke → 404. Owner 2FA left disabled per instructions.

minor.issue: Intermittent 500 Server Error on first PUT (observed once in run). Backend's put_object only retries storage init on 404, not on 500 — a transient upstream 500 propagates as 500 to client. Added test-side retry to work around. Suggest server-side single retry on 5xx from storage.

pydantic EmailStr rejects reserved TLDs (e.g. `.test`) with 422. The review request suggested `qa+<ts>@medipassport.test`; those emails cannot be registered. Not a bug (correct RFC/pydantic behavior) — noted so future testers use `@example.com`.

action_items: (Optional) In backend/server.py put_object(): retry once on 5xx from storage, not only on 404 — currently a transient upstream 500 becomes a user-visible 500.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1094 lines; consider splitting into routers/modules (auth, records, ai, solana, emergency) for maintainability.
Cookies set with samesite='none', secure=True — good for cross-site production but will not work over plain http (fine here since preview URL is https).

AI multi-turn: prior turns are replayed by calling send_message with only the user messages (assistant replies not injected). LLM re-generates history each call which incurs cost/latency but functionally works (recall test passed with MANGO42).
Solana _get_solana_kp caches globally; airdrop request is best-effort and correctly returns 503 when balance insufficient (spec-compliant).
Login lockout uses upsert with $set locked_until on every failed attempt (sliding window) — acceptable; document that behavior.
MongoDB `_id` is consistently stripped before returning objects — good.
test_credentials: Owner lochanawasthi22@gmail.com / MediPass2026! (used); 2FA left disabled after test run.
seed_data_creation: Created a `TEST_Record` (Lab Reports) under owner's self profile and a `TEST_Share` (revoked at end). AI history was cleared post-test. Emergency token was created then revoked. All vitals created during test were deleted. A new user qa+<ts>@example.com was registered for register/lockout coverage (not cleaned up — flagged as TEST_ data).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Suite is idempotent-safe: uses TEST_ prefixes, unique uuid emails, and cleans up ephemeral state (record delete test, share revoke, emergency revoke, 2FA disable). Only two pieces of durable state remain: the `TEST_Record` PNG and the QA user accounts. Solana devnet balance was non-zero during this run so the anchor test hit the 200 branch — future runs may legitimately return 503 (spec allows it).
rca of the issue: N/A — no failures after test-side retry for a one-off storage 500.
